# Pharmacogenomic Findings

```{r pgx_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

pgx_phenotypes_pdf <- cps_report$content$snv_indel$pgx_phenotype
pgx_recommendations_pdf <- cps_report$content$snv_indel$pgx_recommendation
n_pgx_phenotypes <- NROW(pgx_phenotypes_pdf)
n_pgx_recommendations <- NROW(pgx_recommendations_pdf)
pgx_gt_unavailable <- isFALSE(as.logical(
  cps_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$gt_detected))
```

```{r pgx_pdf_gt_unavailable}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pgx_gt_unavailable)
cat(cpsr:::no_findings_pdf(paste0(
  "Pharmacogenomic variants were not assessed - genotype information (GT) ",
  "is not available in the input VCF."), title = "Not assessed"))
```

```{r pgx_pdf_intro}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(pgx_gt_unavailable)
cat(
  "CPIC phenotypes are inferred for genes with detected altered function ",
  "alleles (DPYD, TPMT, NUDT15, G6PD). Each gene is present in two copies; ",
  "the *diplotype* is the pair of CPIC alleles on the two copies (e.g. TPMT ",
  "\\*1/\\*3C - one reference copy and one copy with \\*3C), and determines ",
  "the phenotype.\n\n",
  "*Assumptions*: CPIC allele positions without a called variant are assumed ",
  "to be homozygous reference (not confirmed from the input VCF). Phase is not ",
  "assessed - the assumed configuration of multiple variants in a gene is ",
  "stated in the notes. G6PD (X-linked) genotypes are interpreted as ",
  "hemizygous in males and diploid in females (sample sex: ",
  (if (is.null(cps_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$sex)) "UNKNOWN" else cps_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$sex), ").\n\n",
  sep = "")
```

```{r pgx_phenotype_heading}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_pgx_phenotypes > 0
cat("## Phenotypes\n\n")
```

```{r pgx_phenotype_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr n_pgx_phenotypes > 0

pgx_phenotypes_pdf |>
  dplyr::select(
    Gene = "SYMBOL",
    Alteration = "PGX_VARIANTS",
    Diplotype = "PGX_DIPLOTYPE",
    Genotype = "PGX_GENOTYPES",
    Phenotype = "PGX_PHENOTYPE",
    `Activity score` = "PGX_ACTIVITY_SCORE",
    Note = "PGX_PHENOTYPE_NOTE"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(),
                              ~ dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.x), ""))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(`Activity score` = dplyr::if_else(
    .data$`Activity score` == "n/a", "", .data$`Activity score`)) |>
  ## genotype and phenotype as colored pills (as in the HTML report) - raw
  ## Typst markup, not escaped
  dplyr::mutate(
    Genotype = cpsr:::pgx_genotype_pill_pdf(.data$Genotype),
    Phenotype = cpsr:::pgx_phenotype_pill_pdf(.data$Phenotype)) |>
  tinytable::tt(width = c(0.7, 1.4, 1.8, 1.5, 1.5, 0.8, 2.1)) |>
  tinytable::format_tt(j = c(1:3, 6:7), escape = TRUE) |>
  cpsr:::style_tt_header_pdf() |>
  tinytable::style_tt(j = 1, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r pgx_phenotype_none_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_pgx_phenotypes == 0 && isFALSE(pgx_gt_unavailable)
cat(cpsr:::no_findings_pdf(paste0(
  "No CPIC alleles of altered function were found in DPYD, TPMT, NUDT15 or ",
  "G6PD - no CPIC phenotypes or prescribing recommendations are reported. ",
  "Note that this does not confirm normal function genotypes (positions ",
  "may not be covered by the input VCF).")))
```

```{r pgx_recommendation_heading}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_pgx_phenotypes > 0
cat("## Prescribing recommendations\n\n")
```

```{r pgx_recommendation_source}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_pgx_recommendations > 0
cat(
  "Recommendations from CPIC guidelines (https://cpicpgx.org",
  if ("CPIC_RELEASE" %in% colnames(pgx_recommendations_pdf))
    paste0(", release ", pgx_recommendations_pdf$CPIC_RELEASE[1]),
  "). For multi-gene recommendations (thiopurines), genes without detected ",
  "altered function alleles are assumed to be normal metabolizers. ",
  "*Strength*: CPIC rating of the recommendation - *Strong* (high quality ",
  "evidence, desirable effects clearly outweigh undesirable effects), ",
  "*Moderate* (close or uncertain balance of effects), *Optional* (small ",
  "effects or weak evidence; up to the prescriber) or *No recommendation* ",
  "(insufficient evidence).\n\n",
  sep = "")
```

```{r pgx_recommendation_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr n_pgx_recommendations > 0

pgx_recommendations_pdf |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    RECOMMENDATION = dplyr::coalesce(.data$RECOMMENDATION, .data$PGX_NOTE),
    PGX_NOTE = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(.data$LOOKUP_KEY), NA_character_, .data$PGX_NOTE),
    LOOKUP_KEY = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(.data$LOOKUP_KEY), NA_character_,
      dplyr::coalesce(
        cpsr:::format_pgx_phenotype(.data$PHENOTYPE, .data$ACTIVITY_SCORE),
        stringr::str_replace_all(.data$LOOKUP_KEY, c(":" = ": ", ";" = "; "))))) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Drug = "DRUG_NAME",
    Phenotype = "LOOKUP_KEY",
    `CPIC recommendation` = "RECOMMENDATION",
    Strength = "CLASSIFICATION",
    Note = "PGX_NOTE"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(),
                              ~ dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.x), ""))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Strength = dplyr::if_else(.data$Strength == ".", "", .data$Strength),
    ## phenotype as colored pill (as in the HTML report) - raw Typst markup
    Phenotype = cpsr:::pgx_phenotype_pill_pdf(.data$Phenotype)) |>
  tinytable::tt(width = c(1.4, 1.8, 3.8, 1.0, 1.6)) |>
  tinytable::format_tt(j = c(1, 3:5), escape = TRUE) |>
  cpsr:::style_tt_header_pdf() |>
  tinytable::style_tt(j = 1, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r pgx_recommendation_none_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_pgx_recommendations == 0 && n_pgx_phenotypes > 0
cat(cpsr:::no_findings_pdf(
  "No CPIC prescribing recommendations are available for the detected phenotypes."))
```
